# Data model

**43 tables.** Multi-tenant with a shared schema: every
tenant-owned table carries `org_id`, and every load goes through one
choke point that refuses cross-tenant reads.

Identifiers are UUID4 hex, so rows cannot be enumerated by guessing a
neighbouring integer.
